summary: A Yes vote raises the City of Lemoore's maximum transient occupancy (hotel) tax paid by hotel and vacation rental guests from 8% to 12%, providing revenue for general city services until ended by voters.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports increasing Lemoore’s transient-occupancy tax above its current 8% rate to fund municipal services.
tax.quote: The purpose of this report is to provide the City Council with background information and comparative data on Transient Occupancy Tax (TOT) rates in the region to support consideration of a potential increase to the City’s current TOT rate of 8%.

tax.text: The No position opposes Measure P’s proposed City of Lemoore hotel-tax increase.
tax.quote: California faces a cost-of-living crisis and we cannot have any more tax hikes.
